item.title: Hoshizora no Babylon -Semarikuru Cosmic Sukebe Onee-sans-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: One-up
  • 発売日: 2015-07-24
  • スコア: 7.62/10 (142 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 星空のバビロン －迫り来るコズミックすけべおねぇさんズ－
  • 英語名: Hoshizora no Babylon -Semarikuru Cosmic Sukebe Onee-sans-

あらすじ

In the Universal Century of 2068, men are incredibly rare, and the protagonist, Galaxy Amanogawa, finds himself targeted by the Cosmic Race, a group of humanoid space monster girls appearing from a wormhole. These beings aim to mate with human males for reproduction. Despite Galaxy’s lack of experience, with the help of the ship’s captain and other heroines, they fend off the attacks. However, as a valuable male target, Galaxy remains a constant focus for the Cosmic Race, leading to continued attacks and challenges.

item.title: Hime Jiru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: One-up
  • 発売日: 2014-05-30
  • スコア: 7.68/10 (83 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫汁
  • 英語名: Hime Jiru

あらすじ

The bespectacled and beautiful maid Mitsuka appeared out of the blue one day.

I, who was living alone in Japan, was brought to the Wiekries Kingdom, and made to transfer into the Royal Academy for Royals and Aristocrats as the prince of a forgotten country.

The reason for bringing me to this Academy?

Long long ago, in a time when there were witches, a “curse” was laid on royals and aristocrats.

item.title: Dedenden!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: One-up
  • 発売日: 2013-02-22
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (49 人評価)
  • 日本語名: デデンデン！
  • 英語名: Dedenden!

あらすじ

18 years ago.

Oracle, a top-secret artificial brain, awakens its “personality” and tries to prevent its own extinction, causing a “breakdown”. Public equipment and the Internet instantly came under Oracle’s control. The “war between man and machine,” which triggered the collapse of the human race, broke out.

Washington, Moscow, and London… Famous metropolitan areas are “destroyed” and become debris within 24 hours of the incident. Unmanned weapons just cover the sky. The more troops a country has, the greater the damage.
